tolerance_rationale: Register-before-run, before the first board run of this graph. Code level: int8_tol=2 because the layer contains the int8 RMSNorm chain (its RSQRT is a fixed-point LUT: docs/OP-rmsnorm.md 2.3 registers 4 codes for that chain, and the component run here measured max 2 codes on 6% of the values) plus one fp16<->int8 seam. Quality level: ADR 0005 cosine >= 0.9999 -- registered as the criterion, NOT adjusted afterwards.

quality_criterion.code_criterion: device vs quantised golden: |delta| <= int8_tol codes

accuracy_vs_fp32.note: int8 quantisation error of the whole 4W8A path, no device involved
